`create-code-cli scaffold --export-schema` writes the document below to standard output. Point an editor at it to get completion and validation while authoring `scaffold.yaml`.

```bash
create-code-cli scaffold --export-schema > scaffold.schema.json
```

```json
{
  "schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "title": "ScaffoldConfiguration",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "name",
    "version",
    "projects"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Configuration name"
    },
    "version": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Semantic version (e.g., 1.0.0)",
      "pattern": "^\\d\u002B\\.\\d\u002B\\.\\d\u002B(-[\\w.]\u002B)?(\\\u002B[\\w.]\u002B)?$"
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Optional description"
    },
    "outputPath": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Output directory (default: .)"
    },
    "gitInit": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Initialize git repository"
    },
    "globalVariables": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Global template variables",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "postScaffoldCommands": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Commands to run after scaffolding"
    },
    "projects": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "List of project definitions",
      "items": {
        "type": "object"
      }
    },
    "solutions": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "List of solution definitions",
      "items": {
        "type": "object"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

The schema describes the root keys. The nested shapes are documented on the pages in this section, which are generated from the same model the parser binds to.
